identitySignals: Company's own page states 'TherapyTravelers is now Epic Special Education Staffing', matching the agenda's 'Therapy Travelers dba Epic Special Education Staffing'
Company site describes school-based special education staffing (therapists, psychologists, educators), matching OUSD's Special Education Department contract

Epic's old domain (epicspecialeducationstaffing.com) now redirects to the Seabright School and Therapy Staffing page, and that page's editor's note says Epic Special Education Staffing is now Seabright
research.notes: Brand has changed twice (TherapyTravelers -> Epic Special Education Staffing -> Seabright School and Therapy Staffing, part of Stone Harbor Staffing Group, per the company site). The El Segundo, CA location in the agenda was only seen on third-party listings (LinkedIn, directories), not on a fetched official page, so it is not confirmed here. Contact page showed no phone/email/address in fetched text. Legal entity name and registry IDs not verified (CA SOS / SAM not checked), so confidence is capped at medium.

profile.summary: A national special education staffing firm that places speech-language pathologists, occupational and physical therapists, school psychologists, special education teachers, school nurses and other school-based professionals with school districts. It was formerly called TherapyTravelers, then Epic Special Education Staffing, and now operates as Seabright School and Therapy Staffing within Stone Harbor Staffing Group.

sources.title: TherapyTravelers is now Epic Special Education Staffing
